title: Bead approaching a wall: Brenner drag correction vs gap (frequency response, mixed u-p, analytic)
description:
Optical-tweezer bead approaching a coverslip: a polystyrene bead of radius a = 1 um (E 3.5 GPa, nu 0.34, rho_b 1050 kg/m^3) held by prescribed_displacement_domain 'bead' and moved normal to the wall by X = 1 nm at f = 1 Hz in library water (viscosity mu = 1.002e-3 Pa s, rho = 998.2 kg/m^3, no bulk modulus: an incompressible viscous liquid), axisymmetric (r, z): the wall (coverslip, no slip) is y_lo, the bead centre on the axis at height h, the closed container r < R = 50 um, 0 < z < R with fixed walls x_hi / y_hi (x_lo is the axis). Parameter sweep of h_a = h / a over 1.1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 3, 5 (gap (h - a) / a from 0.1 to 4), one build per value (geometry, mesh and every parameter depending on h_a follow it). solid_mechanics on quadratic triangles, formulation mixed (Taylor-Hood: P2 displacement, P1 pressure), frequency_response at f = 1 Hz alone; mesh 0.15 um inside the bead, a refinement line at mid-gap from the axis to r = 2 sqrt(a g) at g / 4 (g = h - a, at most 0.15 um: graded into the lubrication zone ~ sqrt(2 a g)), growth 1.2, 4 um at most, h_min 10 nm (below the smallest gap size, 25 nm at h / a = 1.1, which the default h_min = 4 um / 100 = 40 nm would floor to ~2.5 elements across the gap) (2.4k - 3.6k triangles per value).
Quasi-static: the viscous depth delta = sqrt(2 mu / (rho omega)) = 0.56 mm is 11 x the container, so liquid inertia enters the real part at O((R / delta)^2) and the dissipative imaginary part only at second order: rho = 1e-3 kg/m^3 instead of 998.2 changes beta by < 1e-9 (h / a = 5, R = 50 and 200 um). (In an unbounded liquid the Basset term would still add sqrt(f / f_nu) = 1.8e-3 at 1 Hz; see bead_drag_water_frequency_response.)
Analytic (Brenner 1961; Happel & Brenner section 7-4; steady Stokes, exp(+j omega t), U = j omega X): the force of the liquid on the bead F = -6 pi mu a U beta, beta = (4/3) sinh(alpha) sum_{n >= 1} n (n + 1) / ((2n - 1)(2n + 3)) [(2 sinh((2n + 1) alpha) + (2n + 1) sinh(2 alpha)) / (4 sinh^2((n + 1/2) alpha) - (2n + 1)^2 sinh^2(alpha)) - 1], cosh(alpha) = h / a (alpha the bipolar coordinate of the bead surface). With q = exp(-alpha) = h / a - sqrt((h / a)^2 - 1) (= exp(-log(h / a + sqrt((h / a)^2 - 1)))), S = sinh^2(alpha) = (h / a)^2 - 1, sinh(2 alpha) = 2 (h / a) sqrt(S) and k = 2n + 1 the bracket is (2 - 2 q^k + k sinh(2 alpha) + k^2 S) / (q^-k + q^k - 2 - k^2 S) (4 sinh^2(k alpha / 2) = q^-k + q^k - 2), so no log or acosh is needed; parameters B_1 (n = 1..10) and B_2 (n = 11..20) hold the 20-term sum, beta_brenner = (4/3) sqrt(S) (B_1 + B_2). Truncation error 5.5e-8 at h / a = 1.1 (terms fall like n exp(-2 n alpha)), below 1e-10 from h / a = 1.2. Checked in a scratch script against the full series: alpha = 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3 give 9.2518, 3.0361, 1.8375, 1.4129, 1.2220, 1.1252 (Brenner's table); small gaps approach the Cox-Brenner lubrication expansion 1 / eps + (1/5) ln(1 / eps) + 0.971 (eps = (h - a) / a; 11.432 vs 11.459 at eps = 0.1), large ones the reflections 1 + (9/8)(a / h) + (9/8)^2 (a / h)^2 (1.1252 vs 1.1262 at h / a = 10). The reaction table of 'bead' is the support force on the bead, F_y = -F - omega^2 m_b X, so F_y_im = 6 pi mu a omega X beta (the bead inertia enters only F_y_re).
Sweep tab: beta_fem = F_y_im / (6 pi mu a omega X) versus h_a over beta_brenner (curve beta_vs_gap_brenner) and the lubrication limit a / (h - a) for context (beta_vs_gap_lubrication, not graded: 10 vs 11.459 at h / a = 1.1, 13 % low, the missing log and constant terms above; useless beyond h / a ~ 1.2). Derived values tab: beta_fem per sweep value against beta_brenner. Field tab: u_abs and the pressure (p > 0 in compression) of the last value (h / a = 5). F_y_re is not graded: in the liquid it is the round-off of the stiff held bead rows (~1e-16 E / (omega mu) ~ 1e-4 of F_y_im at 1 Hz), above the physical inertia (5e-7 .. 1e-5 of F_y_im; seen with a soft bead).
Expected agreement (measured, relative): 5.0e-5, 6.5e-5, 7.4e-5, 4.6e-5, 4.0e-5, 9.2e-5 at h / a = 1.1 .. 5 (3.1 s). Mesh study (scratch, before h_min was set, so its h / a = 1.1 gap sizes of the default and the fine level were floored at 40 nm; every size halved / doubled: n_gap 8 / 2, growth 1.12 / 1.3): coarse 2.0e-4 .. 5.5e-4, fine 6e-6 .. 1.4e-5 (about third order), so the default's 4e-5 .. 7e-5 is discretisation. Container study (R = 25, 50, 100, 150, 200 um): h / a = 5: 1.65e-3, 9.2e-5, 2.9e-5, 2.6e-5, 2.7e-5; h / a = 3: 3.2e-4, 4.0e-5, 2.9e-5, 3.0e-5, 2.8e-5: a force normal to a no-slip wall has a far field decaying like r^-3 (Blake 1971), faster than a free Stokeslet, and the outer-wall correction falls ~R^-4.6, adding 6.6e-5 at h / a = 5 and ~1e-5 at h / a = 3 at R = 50 um (smaller gaps: within the ~1e-5 change of the remeshed container). Tolerance 3e-4 (3 x the largest). Correspondence: an incompressible linear viscoelastic medium G*(omega) gives F = -6 pi a G* X beta in the quasi-static limit (mu -> G* / (j omega)); checked once by adding shear_modulus 10 Pa to the water (a Kelvin-Voigt gel): F_y_re / (6 pi a G0 X) = beta to the same 4e-5 .. 9e-5.

parameters.name: h_a
parameters.description: bead centre height above the wall over the radius, h / a (swept)

parameters.name: h_c
parameters.description: bead centre height above the wall [m]

parameters.name: g_b
parameters.description: gap between the bead and the wall on the axis [m]

parameters.name: X_b
parameters.description: prescribed displacement amplitude of the bead, normal to the wall [m]

parameters.name: f_0
parameters.description: drive frequency [Hz] (quasi-static: the viscous depth sqrt(2 mu / (rho omega)) = 0.56 mm is 11 x the container)

parameters.name: n_gap
parameters.description: triangles across the gap on the axis

parameters.name: h_gap
parameters.description: triangle size along the gap line

parameters.name: r_gap
parameters.description: radial length of the gap line (the lubrication zone ~ sqrt(2 a g))

parameters.name: h_floor
parameters.description: smallest triangle size (mesh h_min), below the smallest h_gap (25 nm at h / a = 1.1; the default h_max / 100 = 40 nm would floor it)

parameters.name: S_b
parameters.description: sinh(alpha)^2, cosh(alpha) = h / a (bipolar coordinate of the bead surface)

parameters.name: beta_brenner
parameters.description: Brenner (1961) drag correction F / (6 pi mu a U), 20 terms

parameters.name: beta_lub
parameters.description: lubrication limit a / (h - a) of the drag correction
